notes: Cassette is logical soft-switch state only; no physical interface.
Floating bus returns configurable approximation byte (default 0xFF).
Disk II: Slot-6 controller, 6-and-2, DSK/PO nibble tracks, synthetic Slot ROM, Esp2DiskTest boot.
6502 RWTS decode in Slot ROM is deferred; host boot loader reads via Disk II latch.
WOZ bitstream backend deferred; NIB host load supported.
Apple Disk II ROM / DOS 3.3 not included.
